equipment_type: EC fan network gateway (fan speed control)
applies_to: ebm-papst EC fans networked over Modbus RS-485 to the ECCN06-CT0 BACnet IP / BACnet MS/TP gateway (up to 18 fans).
summary: The ECCN06-CT0 gateway links up to 18 ebm-papst EC fans (addressed over Modbus RS-485 with EC-Control) to a BACnet IP (Ethernet, the default port) or BACnet MS/TP network. Once 'BMS Control' is switched on at the gateway and written to the fans, the BMS sets each fan's speed as a 0-100 % PWM value through one analog value per fan. The manual's BACnet table lists only these speed commands.
notes: Section 6.4.2 of the manual lists AV 0-17 for the ECCN06-CT0; the other gateway model uses a different instance range.
Object names are printed with typos (FAN_1 appears twice, FAN_11 is missing); they are kept as printed. Instance order follows fan number.
The table has no read/write column; the objects are BMS speed commands, so they are shown writable.
Fan monitoring points are not in this manual.
Source: section 6.4 'BACnet Variable for PWM Input', manual page 22 (18 objects).

source.title: BACnet Gateway Manual - User Manual for ECCN02-CT0, ECCN06-CT0

integration.summary: Address the fans with EC-Control first, pick Ethernet TCP/IP (default) or MS/TP under Settings > BMS Config > Comm. Settings, set the IP or MS/TP parameters and reboot. Turn BMS MASTER on under Settings > BMS Config > BMS Control and write the values to the fans; then write each fan's PWM AV.
integration.enable: BMS control is switched on at the gateway (Settings > BMS Config > BMS Control > BMS MASTER = ON), then written into the fans with WRITE VALUES = YES. The fans then ignore their 0-10 V analog input and take the %PWM written over BACnet.
setup: BACnet IP is active by default: IP 10.0.0.100, mask 255.255.255.0, UDP port 47808 (0xBAC0); set under IP SETTINGS, then REBOOT.
MS/TP defaults: device instance 47000, baud 19200, MAC 1, parity 8E1; change them under MSTP SETTINGS and REBOOT the gateway.
The gateway does not address fans itself; program each fan's Modbus address with EC-Control before setup.
Address the fans (ebm-papst suggests starting at 2, up to 18) and enable them in the gateway before connecting them over RS-485.
gotchas: With BMS control on, the fans' EEPROM set value is deactivated and the analog input is ignored.
A reboot is needed for a new device instance to take effect.
Duplicate object names in the table: map by instance, not name.
